title: Experiment 7 - Prop Hunt
description: A modpack where you can use a wand to hide as any block you want with guns in case you need to hunt down fake blocks!
body:
# Experiment #7 - Prop Hunt

This modpack is a 1.19.2 Fabric modpack built for hide-and-seek, The gameplay revolves around Prophunt, allowing players to shape-shift into nearby blocks to blend seamlessly into whatever blocks are nearby by using a wand! 

However, To keep it all fun and games, seekers are armed with the guns to attack whatever blocks they believe are players

<details>
<summary>Info on why this modpack was made</summary>

This modpack was originally made for my experiment / minievent, However anyone can use this so yk, but you can still gladly enjoy this modpack as to however you see fit!

</details>
